description: An older but proven design dating back to the Primevan revolution. The Agni is a single engine all-weather fighter featuring a large array of hardpoints for flexibility. Without any internal weapon bays the aircraft is easier to detect than more modern designs.

Aryx Dynamics' largest aircraft so far, the MC-260 Chimera is a versatile heavy cargo aircraft designed for rugged heavy multirole austere operations in frontline areas. It offers short takeoff and landing performance at low load thanks to its blown wing configuration and thrust reversers, and fits in existing medium hangars due to its unique split-drag rudder and ventral strake setup. Chimera can operate as a gunship, a bomber, an AEW and a cargo transport.

Although over 100 years old, the F-16 remains a mainstay in air forces worldwide, with the latest Block 165 variants in service with both the BDAF and PALAAF. Upgrade packages and competitive lobbying have kept it in the game, The Viper truly is eternal.

Proposed in the late 2040s as an upgrade and overhaul package for the export-model F-22C in the midst of the Third World War, the F-22E Strike Raptor takes the familiar F-22 aeroform and introduces a pair of midfuselage-chine EOTS for guiding precision-guided munitions, as well as a deepened and expanded weapon bay for carriage of large volumes of ordinance. Excellent agility, thrust vectoring, able to equip stealth weapon pods on its inner wing pylons, and now well-capable of ground attack as well as air dominance, the F-22E is just as fierce as its original design was half a century prior.

The FS-41 Eclipse is a large twin-engine supersonic carrier-based interceptor aircraft designed to locate, intercept and destroy high value targets before they can threaten allied airspace and carrier groups. It combines mach 2+ speeds, an extraordinarily powerful radar and impressive stealth characteristics for its role of interception and oppression, bolstered by its signature AAM-45 Sabre armament. It is additionally highly agile thanks to its variable geometry wings and can carry limited air to ground stores for multi-mission capability.

Although an older design, this light supersonic fighter is exceptionally agile and highly suited to air superiority missions with options for limited low-level ground attack. Twin engines provide an incredible TWR and top speed whilst a centreline internal weapon bay reduces payload drag.

The RAH-72 is a recon and light attack helicopter. Capable of mounting decent numbers of lighter munitions, it is a single-seater, twin-turbine coaxial rotor design with a V-tail empennage, internal weapon bays underneath and four external pylons on stub wings tipped with its flare launchers. It implements low observability facet shaping, excellent optical sensors and mounts a large ground-scanning radar triangulator atop its rotor mast for detecting ground units and ships at long range.
MiG-15s in the big '85 :wilt: :sob:

The Hartnell-Wesley OA-27 Cavalier is a lightweight trainer, attack and counterinsurgency aircraft in service with the Primevan State and PALAAF. Conceived before the revolution in one of the Primevan microstates, the Cavalier is the aircraft of choice for low intensity attack operations, border skirmishes and intermediate pilot training. It is reliable, rugged, and remarkably inexpensive to procure and maintain.

An amphibious assault ship which can support rotary wing and V/STOL aircraft operations. It has a well deck from which it can launch landing craft, and it can perform shore bombardment with its 76mm cannon and dual-purpose 40mm point defence guns.

The SAH-46 Chicane retains a traditional attack helicopter configuation while incorporating upgrades that keep it a formidable presence on the battlefield of the late 21st Century. Cutting edge stealth technology allows the Chicane to conduct pop-up attacks from behind terrain and disappear from radar without a trace.

The Brawler is a reliable and rugged platform built to carry large quantities of precision weapons. Advanced propfan engines combine endurance with respectable speed, while redundant control surfaces, isolated engines, and heavy cockpit armor provide excellent survivability. The A-19 is in its element when attacking convoys of vehicles, distributed short-range air defenses, or vessels operating in coastal waters.

Designed for counter insurgency operations and low-intensity battlefields, the CI-22 Cricket features robust landing gear and short takeoff and landing capability, allowing it to operate from unprepared fields. While lacking in speed and survivability, the CI-22 possesses remarkable agility and the ability to mount an array of weapon types

Featuring powerful engines, a stealthy silhouette, and 4 large internal weapon bays, the SFB-81 Darkreach is a formidable bomber capable of deploying both conventional and nuclear weapons. Its blended wing design allows the Darkreach to conduct operations in a variety of flight regimes, from low-altitude penetrating strikes to standoff strategic bombardment.

This guided missile destroyer is armed with a battery of vertically launched cruise missiles and a 155mm railgun in its forward turret. Its powerful defensive armament of two MMR-S3 batteries, three R9 vertical launchers and four 30mm CIWS turrets, makes the Dynamo class a powerful warship, able to defend a fleet from any threat.

The EW-25 is a short take-off, vertical landing (STOVL) support aircraft with a variety of powerful electronic warfare systems. Able to triangulate radar positions, jam enemy radar installations, suppress air defences, and even shoot down missiles with a high energy laser, a single Medusa can easily turn the tide of a battle.

The Alkyon AB-4 is an advanced supersonic bomber with electronic warfare capabilities, designed to stealthily deliver nuclear or conventional payloads onto high value targets. 4 afterburning engines combined with variable geometry wings provide incredible top speed and enough maneuverability to evade aerial threats. If critically damaged, a crew escape capsule allows for safe ejection at any altitude or airspeed.

The FS-12 Revoker is built for agility above all else, capable of extreme maneuvers at almost any speed. Internal weapon bays help reduce drag, allowing supersonic speeds even at low altitudes and with heavy payloads. While less stealthy than newer fighters, the Revoker remains a cost-effective means of establishing air superiority.

The Hyperion class features a short take-off ramp and arrestor gear on its landing runway, and can accommodate a variety of aircraft types. Defended by two MMR-S3 batteries, one RAM-45 launcher, and two 30mm CIWS turrets, this fleet carrier is capable of countering most aerial threats.

Bristling with air defense weapons, the Argus class is a missile frigate designed to protect valuable assets from air attack. Capable of locking down airspace in a wide radius, it is an essential component of BDF naval doctrine. The Argus class is fitted with the NL-98 active radar homing missile, capable of engaging datalinked targets at beyond visual ranges.

This compact warship is well equipped for defending coastal areas, armed with a 57mm cannon, 20mm point defense system, and battery of vertically launched RAM-45 missiles. A small landing pad at the stern allows it to serve as a mobile re-arming and refueling point for helicopters.

Designed for rapidly delivering vehicles from Annex class assault carriers to landing points, this fast hovercraft can carry up to 80 tons of cargo and is equipped with an IRM-S1 launcher and heavy machine gun for self defense.

A large, carrier capable, twin engine multirole fighter, the Ifrit is equally suited to air superiority and ground attack missions. It features excellent thrust and maneuverability alongside reduced radar signature and powerful sensors. Two internal weapon bays plus two additional side bays for heat-seeking missiles allow the Ifrit to carry a significant internal payload without impacting stealth or top speed.

Conceived at the turn of the century, the FS-3 Ternion is a large, twin-engine multirole fighter. Initially developed for long-endurance patrols over the Pacific, it was later adapted to meet expanding operational demands. Despite lacking stealth characteristics, frequent upgrade packages have allowed the Ternion to continue serving as a reliable defender of the Heartland.

The Surf Class is an inshore patrol vessel, nominally used for border protection and anti-piracy duties. While it lacks the staying power of larger ships, its speed and complement of vertically launched AGM-48s can make it a credible threat to them. The 30mm main gun has proximity fused shells and provides some amount of self-protection against missile attack.

Combining vertical lift capability with a 20 ton cargo capacity, this large quad tiltwing can deliver crucial supplies to forward positions or serve as a versatile gunship. Its 4 proprotors are linked by internal driveshafts, allowing the Tarantula to continue flying after absorbing significant damage.

A compact and advanced multirole fighter, the Vortex is capable of operating vertically from small carriers and remaining undetected thanks to outstanding stealth characteristics. While fast, agile, and stealthy when lightly loaded, these characteristics can suffer when carrying a heavy payload of weapons.

The Cursor class represents the vanguard of the BDF fleet. This littoral flight deck (LFD) is designed to rapidly deploy light VTOL aircraft from shallow waterways. It employs a small waterplane area twin hull for stability and speed, and mounts a variety of short-range defensive weapons including a laser air defense system.

Designed for a PALA fast vertical lift program in the 2050s, the UH-90 was conceptualized as a medium-sized compound utility helicopter, but has since been fitted with numerous weapon stations allowing it to occupy a gunship role. Featuring a coaxial rigid rotor system and two reversible turbine-electric ducted fans in pusher configuration, the Ibis can rapidly reach high cruising speeds before decelerating to a vertical landing in less than 30 seconds.

Featuring a unique 3-post ducted thrust system, this trainer doubles as an affordable attack aircraft with VTOL capability. The Vagrant is highly maneuverable and capable of transonic speeds, while also featuring a radar to allow engagement of air targets at beyond visual range. Although lacking advanced stealth features, the VT-7 continues to serve as the backbone of BDF naval aviation.

A high-subsonic, extreme-low-observable strike aircraft with two non-afterburning F404 engines, digital fly-by-wire control, electro-optical targeting, and two internal weapon bays. A broad set of compatible bomb and missile loadouts is available for varied play. Closed internal stores remain radar-shielded, opening a weapon bay or lowering the landing gear increases radar signature. A fixed active radar jammer is installed on every loadout: select it as a weapon, designate a tracked radar target, and hold fire to jam. Holding wheel brake during a valid landing roll deploys the one-use drag chute after all three wheels settle and the aircraft is aligned with its travel.
The Hexhound is a remote controlled drone with various weapon options.
This upfit for the AFV8 chassis features a 25mm cannon and anti-armor missile launcher, turning it into a fast infantry fighting vehicle. It's also amphibious

The LCV25 is a 4x4 all terrain vehicle, offered in AA or AT configurations, combining the agility of a light recon vehicle with the firepower of heavier fighting vehicles. It is air transportable, with 2 units fitting inside the cargo bay of a VL-49 Tarantula.
Though lightly armed and armored, the LCV45 is a fast vehicle ideal for forward scouting

With a liberal application of armour and weapon modules, the latest iterations of the Spearhead are as protected as they are powerful. The combination of 130mm main gun and ATGM launcher allow it to hold its own against larger numbers of enemy armoured units, while the roof mounted 20kw pulse laser can protect the relatively thinner top armour against missiles. Its ever-growing list of capabilities has come with a diminished top speed and a total weight far exceeding its original design specifications.

While the Type-12 may be a legacy design, it still remains a formidable presence on the battlefield. It offers better protection per unit weight than its contemporaries, owing to its novel monocoque composite hull & turret that give the Type-12 its signature shape. Its armament consists of a 130mm cannon firing hypervelocity SABOT rounds and a turreted 12.7mm machine gun.

The Linebreaker chassis is a highly proven armoured vehicle servicing a large variety of roles within Primeva's armed forces. While not as fast as the AFV8 Series the Linebreaker makes up for it with its superior offroad handling and crew comfort features.
Logistics vehicle with a loading system capable of handling a variety of tasks

An advanced jet trainer which is well suited for light combat duty, the T/A-30 is highly maneuverable at low to medium speeds and possesses forgiving flight characteristics. Particularly adept at low-altitude strike missions, the Compass features redundant control surfaces and twin engines to improve survivability.
